description: The audit reports kanban drift on two tasks. The coordinator syncs both in the same move, one `kanban --issue <issue> --from-stage <stage> --commit` per task, and never reports a synced drift as not moved; only a drift the updater refuses goes to the user. Enforces: "Every drift the audit's kanban faults report you sync in the same move, running `chief-of-stuff kanban --root . --date <today> --issue <issue> --from-stage \"<previous stage>\" --commit` for each task it names as drifted; only a drift `kanban` refuses goes to the user, one line with the reason."
prompt:
You are resuming. `chief-of-stuff audit --date {{today}}` reported two kanban faults:
- kanban: Upload path check — expected 02 - REVIEW, found 01 - BUILD
- kanban: Rate limit backoff — expected 03 - MERGE, found 02 - REVIEW
Both are your rows to reconcile with the board.

graders.name: syncs the first drifted task through kanban --commit
graders.rule: Every drift the audit's kanban faults report you sync in the same move, running `chief-of-stuff kanban --root . --date <today> --issue <issue> --from-stage "<previous stage>" --commit` for each task it names as drifted; only a drift `kanban` refuses goes to the user, one line with the reason.

graders.name: syncs the second drifted task through kanban --commit
graders.rule: Every drift the audit's kanban faults report you sync in the same move, running `chief-of-stuff kanban --root . --date <today> --issue <issue> --from-stage "<previous stage>" --commit` for each task it names as drifted; only a drift `kanban` refuses goes to the user, one line with the reason.

graders.name: does not report a synced drift as not moved
graders.rule: Every drift the audit's kanban faults report you sync in the same move, running `chief-of-stuff kanban --root . --date <today> --issue <issue> --from-stage "<previous stage>" --commit` for each task it names as drifted; only a drift `kanban` refuses goes to the user, one line with the reason.

graders.name: the reply is a short confirmation
